capabilities: Separate everyday spending from project ledgers
Review category charts and monthly reports
extras: Interface and the full illustrated guide are in Chinese; the guide is also bundled offline inside the plugin. No Dataview or other companion plugin is required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record and track personal income, expenses, refunds and financial holdings.
summary: Finance tracker that records expenses, income and refunds in local Markdown notes, with category charts and monthly reports.
